content: Instillation of Hope is based on inspiration provided to participants by their peers. Through the inspiration provided by their peers, patients can increase their expectation on the therapy outcome. BIBREF7 in several studies have demonstrated that a high expectation of help before the start of a therapy is significantly correlated with a positive therapy outcome.
